ePlus AI Toolkit

 Languages: English · Tiếng Việt · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français

A terminal toolkit for Windows, macOS and Linux to inspect Google AI Pro offers through Android, ADB, Frida and Google Play. Windows uses a PowerShell/Python launcher; macOS and Linux use native shell launchers with a shared Python adapter.

 

 [!CAUTION]
 Unofficial project. Potential billing charges. Steps 2–5 can open a real Google Play checkout and may automatically tap Subscribe . An offer appearing in a list, a displayed first-phase price of zero, or a message indicating that the Subscribe action was attempted does not establish eligibility, an active subscription, a free subscription, or a changed renewal date. Verify the exact account, today's charge, future pricing and renewal date directly in Google Play before any checkout.

 [!NOTE]
 At least US$3 available for three separate US$1 transactions—not one US$3 charge. In the currently reported 24-month sequence, Step 2 (initial 12 months), Step 3 (first +6 months) and Step 4 (second +6 months) each involve a US$1 card-verification/payment event : 3 × US$1 = US$3 across three transactions. An event may be a temporary authorization hold rather than a settled charge; the actual amount can differ by bank, account or Google Play. US$3 is the minimum balance for this reported example, not a universal Google fee or a guarantee that US$3 will always suffice . Pending holds may reduce the available balance; according to Google, authorizations are not purchases and typically clear in 1–14 business days , depending on the bank. Verify transaction status and subscription/renewal dates directly in Google Play after each stage. Step 5 is optional and is not part of this three-transaction example. Google Play: Fees, charges & authorizations.

 Disclaimer

 ePlus AI Toolkit is an independent, unofficial project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Google, Google Play, Google One, NetEase or MuMuPlayer.

The software is provided as is , without guarantees of Google AI Pro eligibility, free or extended subscriptions, payment outcomes, account safety or emulator compatibility. Steps 2–5 can initiate real charges , and setup may alter Android, Frida or network settings. Use it only with authorized accounts and devices, comply with applicable terms and laws, and verify every payment and renewal directly in Google Play. Stop/Exit does not undo a submitted checkout.

Read the full disclaimer and security precautions before use. These notices do not remove any liability that cannot legally be excluded.

 Install and prepare

 Choose instructions for your operating system. Windows runs PowerShell; macOS and Linux run native Terminal shells (zsh/bash or sh). PowerShell is not required on macOS or Linux. 

 Software / configuration Windows macOS Linux 
 --- --- --- --- 
 Terminal and shell PowerShell 5.1+ Built-in Terminal , using zsh or bash ; no PowerShell Terminal (sh/bash) ; no PowerShell 
 Python 3.10+ (command: python ) 3.10+ (command: python3 ); launcher creates a local .venv 3.10+ ( python3 ), local .venv 
 Git Install Git for Windows Install Git (Xcode Command Line Tools or Homebrew are options) Git from package manager 
 Android connection Rooted, ADB-enabled Android instance; MuMuPlayer for Windows is supported by the project workflow Rooted Android device or compatible emulator; MuMuPlayer Pro for Mac is an Apple Silicon option, not an Intel Mac solution Rooted USB Android device, one authorized ADB connection 
 Android apps Google Play Store and Google One, signed in to the intended account Same; must be available on the chosen Android device/emulator Google Play Store and Google One on the phone 
 ADB / Platform-Tools Launcher can locate/download ADB when needed Install separately, e.g. brew install android-platform-tools ; verify with adb devices Install Platform-Tools separately; PATH or ADB PATH 
 Frida 16.5.9 , prepared by the Windows setup helper as needed 16.5.9 , installed into the local .venv by the Mac launcher; Android-side compatibility must be checked 16.5.9 , Android 16+ blocked 
 Start command .\run-all.ps1 sh run-macos.sh (or ePlus-AI-Toolkit.command ) sh run-linux.sh 

All three platforms need an authorized, correctly configured Android environment. macOS and Linux expose Steps 0–5, but real Mac/MuMu checkout and Linux rooted-device end-to-end tests remain unverified . See the Windows guide, macOS guide and Linux guide.

 Windows requirements

- Windows with PowerShell 5.1+ and Python 3.10+ .
- MuMuPlayer installed separately , started with an Android instance that permits root and ADB access.
- Google Play Store and Google One installed and signed into the intended Google account inside Android.
- A connection to Android through ADB. The toolkit can locate or download Android SDK Platform-Tools when ADB is missing; it does not install the Android emulator.
- A compatible Frida 16.5.9 host/device environment. The setup helper can prepare Frida, but compatibility depends on the emulator and Android version.

 Step 1 — Install MuMuPlayer

 MuMuPlayer is neither included in this repository nor automatically downloaded by the toolkit. 

Download it from the official MuMuPlayer website (NetEase) , choose the Windows edition, and install it yourself. Avoid third-party download mirrors.

Start MuMuPlayer, enable root and ADB debugging for the Android instance, and ensure Google Play Store and Google One are available. Sign into the Google account you intend to check.

Windows requirements

  • MuMuPlayer installed separately, started with an Android instance that permits root and ADB access.
  • Google Play Store and Google One installed and signed into the intended Google account inside Android.
  • A connection to Android through ADB. The toolkit can locate or download Android SDK Platform-Tools when ADB is missing; it does not install the Android emulator.
  • A compatible Frida 16.5.9 host/device environment. The setup helper can prepare Frida, but compatibility depends on the emulator and Android version.
Step 1 — Install MuMuPlayer

MuMuPlayer is neither included in this repository nor automatically downloaded by the toolkit.

Download it from the official MuMuPlayer website (NetEase), choose the Windows edition, and install it yourself. Avoid third-party download mirrors.

Start MuMuPlayer, enable root and ADB debugging for the Android instance, and ensure Google Play Store and Google One are available. Sign into the Google account you intend to check.

For illustrated setup instructions, use the Install guide on this project's GitHub Wiki.

Step 2 — Get the toolkit

Open PowerShell in the folder where you want to install the toolkit:

git clone https://github.com/hoangsvit/google-ai.git
cd google-ai
.\run-all.ps1

If you already cloned the repository, update it before starting:

git pull --ff-only
.\run-all.ps1

The no-argument command opens the Textual dashboard, installing its pinned dependency on first launch if needed. When you run a check, the environment helper can also install or locate ADB and the pinned Frida version. You generally do not need to execute setup_env.py manually first. Environment preparation may install tools or adjust Android/Frida/emulator settings.

If the terminal shows an ADB error, confirm that MuMu is running and Android debugging is enabled. Where ADB is on your PATH, you can verify the connection with:

adb devices

The device must show as device, not offline or unauthorized. If ADB is not on PATH, let the toolkit locate/install Platform-Tools or follow the detailed troubleshooting guide.

Alternative: use a published release if the latest source fails

If you encounter errors when running the latest repository version, you can try a previously published release from GitHub Releases. Open a release, read its notes, and download the available Windows package if one is attached. If the release only provides GitHub's automatic Source code (zip) archive, download and extract that ZIP, open PowerShell in the extracted folder, and run:

.\run-all.ps1

A source ZIP is not a prebuilt .exe or installer. Keep the release in a separate folder from your current clone so you can compare versions and roll back without overwriting files. Release builds may lack newer bug fixes, and they still require Windows, Python, MuMuPlayer, ADB/Frida and the same billing precautions. If the error persists, check Troubleshooting or report an issue.
